messages:
Alex K: Heads up — NimbleHealth demo Wed 2026-04-08 10:00 PDT. They're planning a load test with ~20 concurrent users hitting the hosted API. Need a short bump to avoid 429s. Can we scope a temporary key?

Jordan (sales): Requesting a 1-hour window 10:00-11:00 PDT. Expected burst ~200 req/min, mostly short prompts (avg ~100 tokens). Prefer ephemeral scoped keys so we can audit and revoke after the demo.

Maria S: @Alex what's the org's current default qps per key? Also will they use streaming or non-streaming?

Alex K: Default is 5 qps/key for hosted. They'll use non-streaming generation for the demo. We want ~15 qps/key during the window. They will create ~10 ephemeral seats.

Raj P: We can issue ephemeral scoped keys with overrides + TTL. Proposal: 15 qps per key, TTL=3600s, and a global org cap of 150 qps to limit blast radius. Need infra sign-off — any production risk concerns?

Jordan (sales): Customer expects <200ms p50. They don't want heavy queuing. Is the fallback to a smaller model automatic if we exceed latency SLO?

Maria S: Yes — we'll enable an automatic model-fallback policy for the window and turn on prefix KV caching for known prompts. I'll also spin up a short-lived dashboard to monitor token/req rates and 429s.

Alex K: Can we also restrict the key to their demo route only and log tokens per request for audit?

Raj P: Yes — scope the key to the /v1/generate route and enable per-request audit logs.

infra-bot: Ephemeral key created: demo-nimble-20260408-01 — qps=15 ttl=3600s — id=ck_demo_abc123. Scope=/v1/generate. Audit logs enabled.

Alex K: Great — please attach the key to the PoC account and email Jordan the key + dashboard link. Also add a note about automatic rotation after the event.

Raj P: Done — key attached, dashboard link posted to the account, and rotation scheduled for +2h. I'll be on standby during the demo window. :thumbsup: 

Jordan (sales): Thanks everyone — I'll confirm with NimbleHealth and share the final test plan.
